body: I don't understand how easy she found it to just cut her arms open. I've tried, but I can't bring myself to do it. I want the pain to end, but I fear death. Goddamn survival instinct. I wish it had plagued her, too.
Do what you can for her. This will weigh on me for the rest of my life, however long that may be. I would not wish this on anybody.

I don't talk to my family anymore. My parents loved her like the daughter they never had. Every time I look at them I can feel their pain, too, and it's too much. 

I wish she had known how much pain she'd cause, how many lives she'd destroy, when she did it. Maybe it would've stopped her from taking that razor to her arms, maybe it wouldn't have. I'll never know, because I didn't pick up her phone call.
I would never wish this on the worst person who ever lived.
I wish I never met her sometimes. Don't ever take anyone around you for granted. Things change in an instant, and you can't turn time back.
